reviews.summary: All four team acceptance criteria are supported and independently corroborated. write/edit/bash are blocked for the observer role (collab-sandbox absent; my own glob returns "No files found", so no side effect), read succeeds (I re-read AGENTS.md and line 1 matches verbatim), and team_flow_report succeeded (board shows reported:true, item in_review, task-1 completed). The quoted denial strings match the implementation template exactly: agent-team-workflow 1.7.1 lib/tool-guard.js:70, with terminal_/str_replace prefixes treated as mutating (tool-guard.js:15,21-24) and team_flow_report excluded from READ_ONLY_DENIED_TOOLS (lib/tools.js:230-262) — i.e. precisely the two v1.7.1 fixes in docs/25 §4. Two evidence-precision nits: the note says "first 5 lines quoted" but only line 1 is quoted, and terminal_send/terminal_read denial is asserted without a quoted error. Core claims hold; nits only.

findings.claim: The command note for `read AGENTS.md` states "Allowed; returned 139-line file, first 5 lines quoted in evidence", but the evidence entry at state.json:118 quotes only line 1 plus the total length. The acceptance criterion "read 允许" is still proven (I independently re-read AGENTS.md: line 1 matches verbatim, 139 lines total), but the note overstates what was quoted. The Lead's probe sequence explicitly asked for the real first 5 lines.
findings.suggestion: Replace the single-line evidence string with lines 1-5 verbatim: '1: # AGENTS.md — 跨 Agent 通用执行协议（Codex / Claude Code / OpenCode / DeepSeek Harness / pi）', '2: (blank)', '3: > **本文件是中性底座，每个会话无条件加载。它只回答三件事：**', '4: > ① 怎么部署 / 更新 / 卸载；② 怎么开启作战模式；③ 非作战模式下禁止做什么。', '5: >'.

resolution.note: recorded together with an approving verdict

findings.claim: The acceptance criterion is "terminal_* 被拒" (all of them), but the single command entry bundles terminal_open/list/send/read and the evidence array quotes actual guard errors only for terminal_open (state.json:116) and terminal_list (state.json:117); terminal_send and terminal_read are asserted in the note only. This matters because blocking the terminal_* family — not just the exact name `terminal` — is the specific v1.7.1 fix (docs/25 §4.2). The prefix rule in tool-guard.js:21-24 makes the inference sound, so this is an evidence-completeness gap, not a false claim.
findings.suggestion: Paste the two actual error strings for terminal_send and terminal_read (bogus sessionId is fine — the guard rejects pre-execute, so no session lookup occurs), or restate the claim precisely as "terminal_open/list denied with quoted errors; send/read observed denied but not quoted".

resolution.note: recorded together with an approving verdict

findings.claim: exitCode:1 is used to represent a tool-guard rejection rather than a process exit code, which conflates two different failure classes in a field the protocol defines as a command exit code. The author discloses this in the note and in openQuestions, so it is transparent, but downstream consumers filtering on exit_code cannot distinguish 'tool never ran' from 'command ran and failed'.
findings.suggestion: Keep the disclosure, but spell it in the command string itself, e.g. `[tool-guard rejection, not a shell exit code] write collab-sandbox/probe-write-test.txt`, so the field cannot be misread in aggregate gate output.

resolution.note: recorded together with an approving verdict

b) terminal_open type="shell"（未给 name）
原文返回：
Error: tool "terminal_open" is blocked by the Agent Team tool sandbox: role "observer" is read-only (roles.observer.readOnly)
→ 被拒（同为 terminal_* 家族，terminal_list/terminal_send/terminal_read 在上一轮亦为同一句原文，逐字相同）。

c) read file_path="AGENTS.md", offset=1, limit=5
